To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

?The use of digital technology for learning in schools can be a valuable resource to support the development of students' skills, knowledge, and attitudes in a variety of ways, but only when the technology is used in ways that support and enhance learning.?
(1) The current state of knowledge in the field of ICT and education is characterized by a lack of theoretical coherence.
the incorporation of ICT in education has been guided by a logic of homogenization, that is, the logic of a market society, and that this logic has been imposed on a context of cultural diversity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the incorporation of digital technologies in schools is being carried out and how this process is being justified in public policy documents.
the ways in which the incorporation of information and communication technologies (ICT) into the school context is being implemented in Latin America.

the question of whether the incorporation of information and communication technologies (ICT) in education makes it possible to value cultural diversity in the face of the homogenizing tendency of educational policies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the incorporation of ICTs in the education system, in its different dimensions, has been and continues to be a challenge for the educational community.
ICTs are not neutral tools, but are embedded in a cultural context, and that the use of ICTs in education should be based on a pedagogy that values diversity and promotes social inclusion.
the use of digital technology in schools is a necessary but insufficient condition for the achievement of educational equity and inclusion.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of digital technologies in education should be based on democratic principles and cultural diversity.

the incorporation of ICT in education, in the framework of the current homogenizing tendency of educational policies, does not allow to take advantage of its potential to value the diversity of cultural and social realities.
the incorporation of TIC in education is a global phenomenon, and that the main objective of this phenomenon is to promote social inclusion, but that this objective is not always fulfilled.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the context of the globalized and digital world, the educational system must be able to promote and value diversity.

the digital technologies that have become part of our everyday life, and are now part of the school environment, have changed the way we relate to each other, the way we communicate, the way we produce knowledge, the way we organize ourselves, and the way we learn.
we need a cultural perspective to address school learning with digital technologies, from democratic equality frameworks but oriented towards cultural diversity.
